label: Uneasy calm
summary: After meeting Qatar's prime minister, Trump called the Iran war 'effectively over' militarily, though the US blockade stays and Tehran rejected his framing. Saudi Arabia intercepted missiles fired at Riyadh after a Houthi attack on the East-West pipeline, which kept operating. Russian, Ukrainian and US negotiators meet in Abu Dhabi for a third round of talks, with territory still the sticking point. At least 39 people died when a migrant boat sank off Senegal, a steel plant blast in Turkey killed 17, and a collapsed sand mound killed five in Gaza's tent camps. Qantas will cut 850 corporate jobs. Brighter notes: CERN reported evidence of a one-in-10-billion particle decay sought for 40 years, NASA set out a 2028 Moon landing plan, and Pope Leo met abuse survivors in Argentina. The weighted formula gave 45; no editorial adjustment.
